description: Composite Fox Moth reconstructed from parts recovered from three Northwest Territories crash sites, a project begun by a Yellowknife resident in 1977 with help from Aero Arctic Helicopters and the territorial government. Suspended in the museum gallery. silverhawkauthor gives the registration as CF-BNI, but Aerial Visuals places CF-BNI at Sault Ste Marie Ontario, so the marking is left blank here.
museum_name: Prince of Wales Northern Heritage Centre
